name: runtime-observation-capture
goal: Harness captures real one-pass synchronous and awaited operation latency and process memory without rerunning effectful behavior tests or replacing results.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Mandatory profiling exposed existing backend behavior tests without captures. The batch profiler repeats operations, so applying it blindly to effectful normal tests would duplicate writes and requests. Add one-pass Harness observations, then integrate only real operation boundaries; unsupported boundaries remain missing rather than borrowed.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing performance-profile suite verifies repeated workload counts, failures and evidence serialization. Extend it to single execution, synchronous identity, awaited completion, rejection identity, invalid input admission, separate callable/workload buffers and honest whole-process RSS. Test operation timing rather than whole test duration.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red056abf08960fbbefec6a5f65d947186af814596dc000491ea498426318ecc007 at80509f46 fails with profiler.observe is not a function. Four one-pass boundary cases fail; the three batch profiling cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Extend the existing profiler with observe, explicit observeAsync and aggregate flush. Execute callbacks once, preserve sync return identity and errors, leave raw promises untouched in the sync path, and measure awaited completion explicitly. Aggregate actual durations and whole-process RSS without retaining test inputs or outputs.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: observe, observeAsync and flush capture actual calls once, aggregate timings without retaining values, preserve sync results/errors and label process RSS. Eighteen focused tests, types, source audit, API build and two real packed-consumer cases pass. Public SDK smoke calls pass in Node and Bun.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed same-process redf38cd1558435021daaaca5076b40a8abc9049aa052f877b7b5c4b9e89f3c7f22 at80509f46 and greend2ed52061f86a491291e0d2387b5b26c870c51f172b5240a91bc24edfa68a75d at5790bba3 pass the unchanged seven-test profiler suite. Four actual self-profile observations cover batch and one-pass operations.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated red snapshot restores the missing API and rejects all four one-pass boundaries. The isolated green snapshot passes the same frozen corpus; pending work cannot become an early latency sample, failures remain failures and fake protocol unit identifiers remain in temporary evidence only.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
